findings.element: Sidebar pinned page rows (e.g. Organizations): the icon area and left padding of the row
findings.finding: Only the text label of a pinned row is a link. The row container shows a pointer cursor and a hover background, but clicking its blue icon or the padding does nothing, while every other sidebar row works as a full-width link.
findings.user_impact: Agents hit these pinned rows many times a day and often click the icon. Some clicks will silently do nothing, which is the KF-5 dead-control pattern on the exact shortcut this feature adds.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the whole pinned row the link, like the other sidebar rows, and keep only the unpin button as a separate target that stops the click from reaching the row.

evidence.action: Hover a pinned row in the sidebar and click its blue icon or the left edge of the row (read from the source; the browser could not connect for a live run).
evidence.observed: The row is a div.sb-item with cursor:pointer and a hover background but no click handler. Only the nested a.lb label navigates, so a click on the icon or padding leaves the route unchanged. Other rows, such as Dashboard, are a.sb-item and navigate from anywhere on the row.

findings.element: Org switcher results list after the search text is edited
findings.finding: After the user edits the query, the previous query's results stay on screen as if they were current, and the next Enter starts a new search instead of picking the highlighted row.
findings.user_impact: Agents who type fast can click or arrow onto an old result that doesn't match what they typed. Or they press Enter expecting to switch orgs and get a spinner instead, which costs an extra step on every quick re-search.
findings.suggested_fix: When the text no longer matches the last search, dim or clear the old results and show that Enter will search, so the list never looks current when it is not.

evidence.action: Search 'xero' and press Enter, then change the text to 'tea' without pressing Enter, then press Enter.
evidence.observed: The list still showed 'Xero Reconciliation (After)' under the 'tea' query until Enter was pressed. That Enter showed the spinner and searched again instead of selecting the highlighted row.

gaps: Unpin from the sidebar: the state map entry is cut off ('focus moves to '), so where focus goes after unpinning is not recorded.

10-pin cap: the cap message was only confirmed visible when the clicked link is near the top of the catalog. Whether it is visible when the 10th pin is a low item (e.g. Outreach > Simple email at 1280x800) was not tested.

Org switcher: pressing Enter in the empty field (opening the switcher and hitting Enter right away) switches to the first Recently viewed org according to the source, but the state map does not record this path.
Browser tool unavailable (CDP timeout twice); UX-1 is reproduced from the source, not from a live click.
